units.pt: iOS points: positions and sizes in UIKit's coordinate space
units.dp: Android density-independent pixels: px × 160 ÷ density, kept to 2 decimals

ios-2026-10-14.what: A UIKit probe app reads the screen, the window, the safe-area insets, the size classes, the status bar's frame and whether it is hidden, and an inline navigation bar's frame, once per device and orientation (status and navigation bars read 2026-10-15). The iPhone Duo's readings are from 2026-11-02, with the probe linked against the iOS 27.1 SDK.

ios-tabbar-2026-11-01.what: The same probe with a UITabBarController: the tab bar's frame with three tabs, and the capsule's gap to the side edges with five tabs with long titles.

ios-poses-2026-10-15.what: A SwiftUI and UIKit probe reads the window, the insets, the size classes and the reserved regions (occlusion and division) in each interface orientation and, on the iPhone Duo, in each hinge pose.

ios-tent-2026-10-16.what: The iPhone Duo's cover display with the hinge partly open (tent), closed, and its inner display half open, read with the same probe on runtime builds 24A94232 (2026-10-16) and 24A94425 (2026-10-17).

ios-runtimes-2026-11-09.what: A SwiftUI probe app on iOS 18.6, 26.5, 27.0, 27.1, 27.2 and 27.3 beta: the window, the insets, the status, navigation and tab bars, SwiftUI's concentricCornerRadii for a view that fills the window, and contentMargins(for: .container). On iOS 18.6, the corners of the view behind a full-screen sheet stand in for the concentric radii.

android-2026-10-14.what: adb: `wm size` and `wm density` for pixels and density, `dumpsys window` for the status and navigation bars' rectangles and the display cutout's insets, `dumpsys display` for the rounded corners; rotations 0 and 1, with the Settings app in front.

android-small-phone-2026-11-01.what: The same adb readings on an emulator of 1080 × 2340 px at 480 dpi with the hole-punch cutout overlay; rotations 0 and 1.

android-poses-2026-10-15.what: A Jetpack Compose probe reads the window, WindowInsets by type (system bars, display cutout, safe drawing), the window size classes in their V1 and V2 forms and the folding features, at rotations 0 to 3 and, on the foldables, closed, half open and open.

android-topbar-2026-10-15.what: The Compose probe with a Material 3 TopAppBar inside the safe area, at rotations 0 to 3 and in each posture.

android-status-bar-2026-11-02.what: adb `dumpsys display`: the display cutout's bounding rectangle in pixels, at rotation 0.

android-tabbar-2026-11-01.what: The Compose probe with a Material 3 Scaffold and a NavigationBar of three items, edge to edge.
